paragraphs: R. Chanina bar Minyomi said to Abaye: Bava Batra 131a. Rav Nechumi—or some say R. Chanina bar Minyomi—said to Abaye: Menachot 70a. [The retrieved Bava Batra has the two-name alternative; Menachot names Chanina alone.] Yoma 45b: R. Chananyah bar Minyomi taught in the school of R. Eliezer ben Yaakov; see there. That matter in Zevachim 83b has R. Chanina bar Minyomi “in R. Eliezer ben Yaakov”; likewise Menachot 26b has R. Chanina bar Minyomi teaching “in R. Eliezer ben Yaakov.” It should read “in the school of R. Eliezer ben Yaakov.” [The retrieved Menachot already has this reading.] R. Acha bar Minyomi and Rav Yosef bar Minyomi—perhaps they were brothers.
